jobs.occupation: Position for doctoral candidate (Dr. rer. nat. / PhD) in infectious disease immunology (m/f/x) fo... (Mikrobiologe/-biologin)
jobs.description: The Friedrich-Alexander-University (FAU) Erlangen-Nürnberg has been rated as one of the most innovative universities in Europe by Reuters or Times Higher Education. FAU and the University Hospital Erlangen (UKER) , which are located in the City of Erlangen in the North of Bavaria, Germany, carry out top-level research in immunology and have consistently ranked among the most successful German universities in attracting funding from the German Research Foundation ( Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft, DFG ) in the medical field of "Microbiology, Virology and Immunology". The FAU Profile Center Immunomedicine (FAU I-Med) unites more than 130 independent research groups from FAU, the UKER and the Max Planck Center for Physics and Medicine, which participate in numerous DFG-funded research  consortia and provide a strong scientific environment.One of these DFG-funded research consortia is the Research Training Group (RTG; Graduiertenkolleg, GRK) 2740 "ImmunoMicroTope" , which has been headed by Prof. Christian Bogdan since 2022. It is run by 13 outstanding research group leaders of the University Hospital Erlangen and the FAU and maintains close cooperations with two laboratories at the Universities of Regensburg and Cologne. The RTG 2740 focuses on the in situ analysis of the tissue microenvironment, the micromilieu factors and the metabolites that determine the immune response against bacterial, parasitic and fungal pathogens. The overarching goal of the consortium is the characterization of the complex "immunomicrotope" during infections (Bogdan et al., Trends in Parasitology 2024 10.1016/j.pt.2024.07.013 ( https://doi.org/10.1016/j.pt.2024.07.013 ) ).Your tasks:Within the RTG2740 "ImmunoMicroTope ", Prof. Christian Bogdan offers a PhD position in his dynamic research team in the project B2 "Role of sex and microbiota for the curative effect of L-arginine in chronic cutaneous leishmaniasis due to Leishmania mexicana infection".Type 2 nitric oxide synthase (NOS2) converts the amino acid L-arginine in the presence of molecular oxygen into nitric oxide (NO), which exerts antimicrobial and immunoregulatory functions. In previous studies, Prof. Bogdan's group showed that NOS2 is essential for the type 1 T helper cell-dependent control of intracellular pathogens, including the protozoan parasite Leishmania. In contrast, the expression of arginase 1 correlated with the progression of disease, pathogen persistence and immunopathology. Moreover, the group observed that the non-healing, chronic course of cutaneous leishmaniasis in Leishmania mexicana- infected female mice was prevented and reversed by external application of L-arginine. Currently, it is unclear, whether this effect is sex-dependent and whether it is influenced by the cutaneous and/or intestinal microbiota. The project aims to address these questions and to provide new mechanistic insights into the therapeutic effect of L-arginine with the ultimate goal to establish a new host-targeted treatment for chronic cutaneous leishmaniasis.For more information, please visit www.immunomicrotope.de ( https://www.immunomicrotope.de/beispiel-seite/project-areas/project-area-b-metabolism/b2-characterization-and-integrative-bioinformatic-modeling-of-metabolic-and-micro-milieu-factors-promoting-leishmania-survival/ ) and www.mikrobiologie.uk-erlangen.de/en/research/research-groups/research-group-of-prof-c-bogdan ( https://www.mikrobiologie.uk-erlangen.de/forschung/forschergruppen-arbeitsgruppen/ag-prof-c-bogdan/ ) /.( http://www.immunomicrotope.de/ )Essential experience/qualifications:- Master’s Degree in immunology or a related subject of life sciences (e.g., microbiology/microbiome research, parasitology, cell biology)- Excellent academic performance and high level of scientific interest- Practical and theoretical experience in the field of infectious disease immunology and microbiome analyses- Very good knowledge of bioinformatic programs and experience in bioinformatic analyses- Experience in mammalian cell culture, cell and molecular biology methods (e.g., flow cytometry, RNA/DNA isolation, quantitative PCR, ChIP, bulk and scRNAseq) and fluorescence (confocal) microscopy- Enthusiasm for experimental and bioinformatic work and for establishing new experimental methods and techniques- High responsibility, initiative, ambition, and motivation- Team spirit- Very good English language skills (C1 level or higher)- Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, Prism, Illustrator etc.Additionally beneficial are:- Experience with experimental in vivo mouse models- FELASA B certificate- Experience with imaging methods- Experience in the field of parasitology- Knowledge of the German languageComments:- The program starts on July 1 st 2027- The PhD position is available for initially 36 months- Pay grade is determined according to the qualifications and personal requirements as defined by TV-L E13- Please provide a single PDF file (last name_first name.pdf ) consisting of the following documents in English language:- Completed application form (RTG 2740 Application form_PhD; www.immunomicrotope.de ( https://www.immunomicrotope.de/how-to-apply/ ) )- Curriculum vitae- Letter of motivation- One-page summary each of the bachelor and master thesis- Copies of the university entrance exam, Bachelor exam and Master exam- Two letters of reference- Other credentials and information relevant to the RTG2740 programPlease note that applications that do not fulfill these formal requirements, will not be considered. Deadline for application is January 15, 2027. The recruitment symposium will take place at the end of February 2027.We offer:- Participation in the 3-year qualification program of the RTG2740, which combines profound, internationally oriented scientific training with an early exposure to important aspects of translational research- Well equipped lab with access to the latest technologies (e.g., bulk and scRNA sequencing; microbiome analysis; confocal, light sheet and high-resolution microscopy; transcriptomics) and core-facilities- A stimulating, collaborative, and international research environment formed by the FAU Profile Center Immunomedicine ( https://www.immunology.fau.de/ ), various collaborative research consortia, and the Max-Planck-Center for Physics and Medicine- Continuous supervision and advice by a scientific mentoring committee- Participation in national and international workshops, symposia, conferences, and an international laboratory exchange- All public service benefits, including supplementary benefits from the Federal and State Government Pension Fund (VBL)Further information:Prof. Dr. Christian BogdanResearch group leader, head of the institute and spokesman of RTG2740Tel. +49 9131 8532561Dr. Ilka KnippertzScientific ManagingTel.: +49 9131 8532571Applications:Universitätsklinikum ErlangenInstitut für Klinische Mikrobiologie, Immunologie und HygieneProf. Dr. Christian BogdanWasserturmstraße 3-5D-91054 Erlangen, Germany

jobs.description: About usAirbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.Job descriptionIn order to support the Electrical Systems department, Airbus Defence and Space is offering anInternship (d/f/m) - Electrical Engineering and TestAre you looking for an internship and want to get to know the work of a Space Electrical Engineer (d/f/m)? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Electrical Systems department as an intern (d/f/m)!- Location: Immenstaad / Friedrichshafen- Start: 01.03.2027- Duration: 3-6 monthsSatellites are composed of highly sophisticated subsystems, equipment and payloads. There units communicated with each other and towards other satellites and ground stations by high frequency electrical or optical signals. Electromagnetic compatibility and immunity (EMC) of all these subsystems, equipment and payloads are essential for reliable satellite operations and final mission success. EMC is subsequently taken into account early on in the project and up to final acceptance by design rules, analysis, inspections and tests.In the frame of an internship of 3-6 months within an EMC laboratory, existing and partially automated test setups shall be upgraded and extended. Correct function and performance shall be verified by reference tests. Test equipment, computer and software shall be functionally integrated. This includes adaptation of existing test scripts. Tasks will be performed in close collaboration with experienced engineers and will partially be utilized in running projects. The implementation shall be done in LabView, Visual Basic and MatLab.The department in which this internship will be allocated is responsible for the engineering and the verification of electrical systems of satellites for earth observation, navigation and science. The department supports all satellite projects in Friedrichshafen. This support includes the fields of RF communications, electromagnetic cleanliness, electrical power supply, harness design and data processing. It includes a broad band of services in the field of analysis and test.Your locationAt the Airbus site in Immenstaad on Lake Constance, you’ll work where the future of Connected Intelligence, Space, and Air Power takes shape. jobs.description: About usAirbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.Job descriptionIn order to support the physical design process support, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a3DEXPERIENCE & DMU Data Specialist | Physical Design & Engineering IT (d/f/m)Ready to help shape the future of flight? As a DMU (Digital Mock-Up) Data Integrator at Airbus, you will be at the heart of our virtual aircraft development. While hundreds of engineers design structural, cabin, electrical, and hydraulic systems across various ATA chapters, you bring the pieces together. You will build, maintain, and validate our central 3D master model—turning individual CAD subsystems into a seamless, Configured DMU (cDMU). By detecting geometric clashes and ensuring flawless spatial integration early on, you prevent costly production issues before the first part is ever built.MissionTo deliver daily operational support to design engineering teams, maintain high data quality standards, and drive user adoption of 3DEXPERIENCE (3DX) and standardized physical design processes across all sites to achieve Right-First-Time quality and Cost of Non-Quality (CNQ) reductions. In this role, you will support strategic, mission-critical programs and sovereign defense technologies, ensuring the digital integrity of next-generation defense platforms.Your locationAt the Airbus site in Immenstaad, you work exactly where the future of Connected Intelligence, Space, and Air Power is taking shape. In an environment that offers visionary perspectives, you shape technological innovations across multiple domains.Our location thrives on dialogue: on campus, you will encounter a unique network of experts in satellite technology, military aviation, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, as well as the combat cloud and ground support systems of tomorrow. The way we work together is equally dynamic—in agile teams, we tackle the most complex challenges, ranging from AI-powered Earth observation to secure cloud architectures. Anyone seeking technological excellence and interdisciplinary collaboration will find the ideal environment here.Our Benefits for You- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facility- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.Your tasks and responsibilitiesEnd-User Support & Incident Resolution (Primary Focus)- Transversal Helpdesk Support: Manage and resolve daily functional helpdesk requests (via Jira) from Design Office engineers across European sites covering CAD workflows, 3DX platform usage, and specialized PMTD tools.- Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis: Investigate and resolve daily operational issues, including 3DX data corruption, access rights, interface errors, and modelling inconsistencies.- Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Author, update, and maintain clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), user guides, drop-in FAQs, and troubleshooting articles for design engineering teams.3DX Data Quality & naming conventions.- BOM & Structure Support: Assist in verifying Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) structures, multi-level Bills of Materials (BOMs), and master data integrity across design lifecycles.- Migration Verification: Validate data integrity during data synchronization and migration activities into the target 3DEXPERIENCE environment.Cross-Pillar Operational Support & Testing into actionable tool/process improvement requests.- Process Standardization & Remote Floor Support: Conduct virtual drop-in support sessions, hands-on coaching, and practical demonstrations to help design engineers across all sites adopt non-divergent 3DX processes.Desired skills and qualifications- Education & Experience: Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering,
